veranderings.voor: Gesinne by hul huise en groepe bure in gemeenskapstuine kry so vars kos
veranderings.na: So kry gesinne by hul huise en groepe bure in gemeenskapstuine vars kos
veranderings.rede: The long subject delays the verb and buries 'so'; fronting 'So kry' links the sentence to the one before and reads more naturally, with no change in words or meaning.

veranderings.voor: Van mielies maak ons pap en van koring
veranderings.na: Van mielies maak ons pap, en van koring
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (ons maak).

veranderings.voor: Van suikerriet kry ons suiker en van sonneblomme
veranderings.na: Van suikerriet kry ons suiker, en van sonneblomme
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (ons kry).

veranderings.voor: om klere en lap van te maak
veranderings.na: om klere en lap daarvan te maak
veranderings.rede: The stranded 'van' has no clear antecedent in this purpose clause; 'daarvan' refers clearly back to katoen.
A list of three actions takes commas, not a repeated 'en'; the protected 'Die meeste avokado's' is untouched.
Dried fruit as a product is the compound 'droëvrugte'; written apart it means fruit that is dry, and the change saves a word.

veranderings.voor: Boerdery waar die boer gewasse of diere produseer
veranderings.na: Boerdery waar 'n boer gewasse of diere produseer
veranderings.rede: A glossary entry is read on its own, so the definite 'die boer' has no antecedent; the indefinite article fits a definition.

vlae.blok: Vir die gesin of vir die winkel
vlae.rede: The comparative 'kleiner' compares with farms not yet named, and the same block later says farm size is not the real difference; changing it to 'klein' would harden it into an absolute claim, so it is left for the reviewer or writer to judge rather than changed.
